scope: Actual local tiny GLM CPU reference parity; not full-model or hardware throughput evidence
baseline_failure: The inherited golden tail assertion fails on the reference before comparing candidate output.
protocol: Load save_tiny from tests_ultra/conftest.py, setting torch threads=1 and torch.manual_seed(521) via that fixture; construct/save the unchanged tiny GLM fixture in a fresh temporary directory.
Set MLX default device to mx.cpu and construct AirLLMNextModel using tests_next/test_native.py options (float32, CPU, prefill_chunk=2).
For each prompt generate the CPU reference twice with attention_mask=ones_like(ids), max_new_tokens=8, do_sample=False and assert exact repeated sequence.
Generate eight tokens with the candidate and assert exact equality with the current CPU reference.

Repeat eight cached forward steps from the original prompt; compare candidate last-token logits with reference last-token logits using np.testing.assert_allclose at unchanged atol=4e-6, rtol=3e-4. Feed each reference argmax as next input.
Record maximum absolute errors at each cached step and actual DSA tie fallback counts.
test_repair: Replace the backend-specific reference golden tail with current-reference repeat-call determinism; retain exact candidate token equality, the DSA fallback assertion, and cached-logit comparisons unchanged.
cause_limit: Observed reference output drift is established. Dependency or top-k implementation changes are plausible causes; the exact historical cause was not isolated.
